name: wild_camera_trap_dataset_benchmark
description:
A camera trap dataset created as a subset of the Wildlife Conservation Society (WCS) camera trap dataset, af featured on: https://lila.science/datasets/wcscameratraps.
The subset contains 10,000 images split into a training set of 2,000 images and a validation set of 6,000 images of 10 species of animal, namely dasyprocta punctata, pecari tajacu, leopardus pardalis, mitu tuberosum, loxodonta africana, aepyceros melampus, equus quagga, madoqua guentheri, unknown bird, and crax rubra, featuring… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/jnle/wild_camera_trap_dataset_benchmark.
reputation: A small, focused academic benchmark used for species recognition experiments; less widely adopted than larger camera-trap collections but useful for controlled evaluations.
